MAIN EXACT PROMPT:
Create a separate new fully transparent RGBA 2D game animation atlas using the attached ORIGINAL character portrait as the authoritative design. Preserve exact anatomy, colors, silhouette, materials, equipment and proportions. Do not modify the portrait. Large square canvas with EXACTLY8 equal columns and8 equal rows,64 different SMALL independently articulated full-body poses. Every COMPLETE silhouette including wing, tail and held club occupies AT MOST38 percent of each cell width AND height. Wide empty transparent horizontal/vertical gutters, safe borders; no pose or bounding rectangle overlaps a neighbor. Direction columns E true right-facing side/profile, SE front-right, S FRONT chest and face toward viewer/screen down, SW front-left, W true left-facing profile, NW back-left, N full BACK away/screen up with no frontal face visible, NE back-right. Rows1 relaxed idle,2 distinct breathing idle,3 walking phase A,4 phase B,5 phase C,6 attack windup,7 attack contact toward that compass direction,8 recovery. All64 show articulated anatomy, never identical/scaled/translated stills. Entire creature and held item stay connected. No text, grid, floor, shadow, detached particles, blood, haze or added equipment; outside painted silhouette alpha0. Match the original detailed dark-fantasy 2D game sprite shading. Preserve the exact original bald stocky broad-bellied brown-gray humanoid brute, heavy shoulders and rounded belly, small rough face, thick bare arms, short thick legs, worn simple brown/beige loin wraps and the same large heavy gray/brown club with the blue-gray handle shown in its hands. N must show back of bald head, shoulder/back anatomy and back of original waist wrap, no front face or belly facing backward. Keep every club end inside its own cell.

Preserve the exact original bald stocky broad-bellied brown-gray humanoid brute, heavy shoulders and rounded belly, small rough face, thick bare arms, short thick legs, worn simple brown/beige loin wraps and the same large heavy gray/brown club with the blue-gray handle shown in its hands. Do not replace its original held object with a sword, axe, shield, or armored warrior. Preserve its body proportions and neutral earthy palette. Three actual alternating planted-foot walking phases; attack pulls the original club back with a stable grip, strikes forward in its direction on contact, then recovers.
